---
title: "Updated Phase Portraits"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)
library(fishualize)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
M1data <- read.csv("M1j0synced.csv")
M2data <- read.csv("m2_j0rank.csv")
M3data <- read.csv("m3_j0rank.csv")

# Find global minimum and maximum prediction error
min_error <- 0

max_error <- 1.5

```

```{r}
# Create phase portrait
m1j0phase <- ggplot(M1data, aes(
  x = jpos0,
  y = jvel0
)) +

  # Individual data points
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = abs(err_norm)),
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Zero velocity reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Custom prediction error colour scale
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "lightblue",
      "lightskyblue",
      "salmon",
      "red",
      "darkred"
    ),
    limits = c(min_error, max_error),
    name = "Prediction error"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "M",
    x = "Joint angle (rad)",
    y = "Joint velocity (rad/s)"
  ) +

theme(text = element_text(size = 12),  axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title =element_text(size = 12))

#ggsave("phaseportrait_M1J0_nrmse.png", plot = m1j0phase, width = 12, height = 8)
#print(m1j0phase)
```

```{r}

combined_phase_j0<-(
  m1j0phase +
  m2j0phase +
  m3j0phase 
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Joint 0: Where Predictions Go Wrong")

combined_phase_j0

ggsave(
  "phaseportraits_allM_j0.png",
  plot = combined_phase_j0,
  width = 16,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 300
)
```
